description: This is the main entry point for a Flutter-based restaurant application. It initializes app-wide services like environment variables, theme, routing, and several state providers to manage authentication, menu, cart, order, reviews, loyalty, and notifications. Additionally, it defines the main widget structure (_MyAppState) that sets up the app's providers and routes.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root stateful widget for the app, responsible for initializing services and setting up the widget tree with providers and routing.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point initializing Flutter bindings, environment variables, system settings, shared preferences, and running the root widget.

methods.name: _MyAppState.build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, setting up multiple providers and configuring the MaterialApp with theme, localization, and routes.
